messages:
marta: quick PSA  our office fantasy playoffs pool starts this weekend. top 3 get donuts, loser buys coffee for a week. who's in? :doughnut:

nick: in. already drafted my revenge lineup. stacking studs and hope.

devin: hold up, aren't we doing keeper rules? last year i lost because i benched the breakout TE.

marta: reminder: playoffs pool uses current rosters, no FA pickups during playoff weeks. keepers locked.

zoe: genius. saves me from impulse streaming. also can someone remind me how points for return TDs work?

nick: return TD = 6 points per rules doc (link in pinned). also special teams yardage bonus kicks in if total >100.

pool-bot: rules summary posted: https://docs.example/office-fantasy-playoffs (scoring highlights: passing TD 4, rush TD 6, return TD 6)

devin: bet proposal: $10 side-pot for exact final score prediction of Sunday night game. winner gets a box of donuts from @marta.

marta: i accept the terms but reserve the right to choose donut shop. premium only.

zoe: i'm in for $10. predictor must post a screenshot of the TV score to claim prize. no backdating. :camera:

nick: also tiny wager: if someone picks an injured player and he scores, they get double bragging points. moral hazard encouraged.

marta: rules committee (me) vetoes double bragging for injured pickups. but we can have a consolation meme contest for shame.

pool-bot: reminder set: finalize playoff roster screenshots by 1:00pm Saturday. automated checks run at 1:05pm; emails sent for mismatches.

devin: submitting rosters now. may the best bench decisions win.

zoe: may my waiver wire ghosts rest in peace.

marta: final note: meetup Saturday 6pm in kitchen for quick bracket reveal + donut treaty signing. bring your best celebratory chant.

nick: i have a chant involving kazoo. you have been warned.
